description: This file contains the implementation of a SwiftUI-based web chat interface for MacOS, including transport protocols, window management, and view model setup.

classes.name: WebChatSwiftUIWindowController
classes.description: A class managing the display and interaction of the web chat window/panel, including presentation, positioning, and event monitoring.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Displays the chat window, bringing it to the front and activating it.

methods.name: presentAnchored
methods.description: Presents the chat window anchored to a specific location or UI element.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the chat window and performs cleanup.
